card.summary: No free tier named. The product is sold through a store: "Checkout stays in sync with the store - the price you see on /nt is the price you pay at store.serv...

free_tier.stated: No free tier named. The product is sold through a store: "Checkout stays in sync with the store - the price you see on /nt is the price you pay at store.serververs.com." That store page carries no price.

egress.terms: No allowance is published on the docs, the /nt page, the /network page or the store product page.; ingress: tcp+udp

record.interface_detail: Install command plus dashboard; "Manage your account and tunnels from your own scripts. Premium feature."
record.tooling: one-line installer; customer API as a premium feature
record.chaining: Designed exactly for this shape: a Linux box anywhere gets a routed public IP without moving into a datacentre.
record.binding_note: With no published allowance, the first thing that fails at 1 TiB/month is the vendor's own judgement rather than a counter. The beta status is the bigger risk: "Network Transit is currently in beta. Breaking changes may occur between minor versions."

identity_cost.detail: A dashboard login at labs.serververs.com issues the install command; the signup form and payment step were not read.

record.reliability_note: Beta service with breaking changes between minor versions; no uptime figure published.
record.confidence_note: Registration API flow and service features are documented. Commercial pricing and transfer allowances are unverified.

evidence.proved: token-based install command, WireGuard transport, routable public IP on a machine behind NAT, beta status
two buy paths, IP lease and transit, both sold through the store; no price shown
the product page exists and carries marketing copy but no price

record.price_per_tb_month: unverified: no price on /nt, /network, the docs, or the store product page
record.notes: serververse.io does not answer; the live brand is serververs.com, with docs.serververs.com and store.serververs.com. The install-command design is the notable part: it removes the config-file step entirely, which is why wg_path is registration-api rather than native-conf.

extras.wg_detail: Provisioning is a token, not a file: "Your personalised install command - including your provisioning token - is generated for you" and "Serververse provisions your tunnel on the edge network and your server receives a routable public IP." The transport is named: "Traffic is routed through the Serververse edge network over a secure WireGuard tunnel". A customer API exists as a premium feature.
extras.volume_stated: No allowance is published on the docs, the /nt page, the /network page or the store product page.
extras.transit_note: The vendor's edge network announces and routes the address.
